analysis.title: DeskTalk - Safe-haven scramble
key_insights: A sharp rotation out of US equities into Treasuries followed a flurry of headlines, leaving investors on edge ahead of Nvidia earnings after the close, a major US equity issuance on Thursday, and geopolitical developments from President Trump's Asia trip.
A trilateral meeting between Trump, Xi, and Putin is slated for 01:30 EST on Thursday.
A CNN report says the NSA's internal communications network is down after a series of outages this week. The report says there is no evidence of a cyberattack.

The SPX fell 1% and was down more than 1.5% at its lows, led by software and tech shares. The NDX fell 1.4% and was down more than 2% at its lows, then pared losses after former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang released a statement saying he would be 'honored to answer the calls' for his reinstatement.
Gold, Treasuries and Citi's US Long/Short Risk Index (CISURISK) all moved higher. The benchmark US 10y yield (5.10%) fell more than 7bps peak to trough, and the gains have since become more modest.
The dollar reversed lower, with DXY falling to 103.42 after initially rallying on a firmer-than-expected US retail sales print.

The eFX desk reports volumes 81% above average between 07:30 EST and 10:30 EST, with net buying in USD and JPY. EUR selling was driven mainly by corporates and investors, and EURCHF activity picked up materially.
Nvidia's earnings after the close are the key catalyst. Investors are focused on whether management addresses the mounting calls for Jensen Huang's return.
earnings_insights: Nvidia (NVDA) reports earnings after the close today. The note gives no EPS or revenue estimates. Focus is on whether management addresses calls for Jensen Huang's return.
